## 2024-06-14 - Improve Swagger DX for FastAPI
**Learning:** For backend-only API repositories without a frontend UI, UX enhancements should focus on Developer Experience (DX), such as improving auto-generated OpenAPI/Swagger documentation metadata to make it more readable and intuitive for developers consuming the API.
**Action:** Enhance FastAPI application instances with `description` and `version`, and enrich endpoints with `tags` and parameter descriptions.
